title: Laugenbrezeln
description: Bavarian lye-style pretzels with a deep mahogany crust, a soft chewy crumb, and coarse salt — made at home with baked baking soda.
notes: Best eaten the day they are baked, with butter or sweet mustard.

steps.text: Mix the bread flour, yeast, sugar, salt, butter, and warm water and knead to a firm, smooth dough.
Cover and leave to rise until puffy.
Divide into 8, roll each into a 60 cm rope, thicker in the middle, and twist into a pretzel.
steps.tip: Lift both ends, cross them twice, and press them onto the fat belly.

steps.text: Refrigerate uncovered so a skin forms.
steps.tip: The skin keeps the shape crisp in the bath.

steps.text: Spread the baking soda on a tray and bake it for an hour first, which turns it into a stronger alkali. Dissolve it in the water and bring to a simmer.
steps.tip: Wear gloves. Baked soda is caustic enough to irritate skin.

steps.text: Dip each pretzel for 20 seconds, lift onto a lined tray, slash the belly, and sprinkle with pretzel salt.
